manifest.scope: Production artifact with scoped WebDriver script results only during repeated edits. Complete persisted source, current syntax and geometry are verified before every next action. Default single-input observations are preserved. Retained cohorts explicitly collect all owned targets and are excluded from latency acceptance; natural cohort has no forced GC and supplies latency and resident peak. No application code or production artifact changed.

candidate.scope: Viewport candidate; consult the separate verification receipt for complete-source CI status. Complete-row HTML reuse preserves CSS-only wrapping, bounded fragments require current source/syntax/glyph ownership, and warm wrapped preparations coalesce through a task. Original recovery transport. Native device and new hosted checks remain pending.

memoryCycles.scriptResultScope: Repeated synchronous script results use ChromeDriver object groups through an owned root element; original script arguments are restored before execution. Initial single-input observation is unchanged.
memoryCycles.scope: Native one-character beginning edits and Control-Z. Full persisted source must alternate before each next action. No clipboard, changed readiness deadlines or synthetic source publication. Checkpoints follow confirmed autosave and syntax/layout readiness. Peak sampling spans cold startup, original input and all cycles. Explicit collection covers all owned page/worker/service-worker heaps at checkpoints; complete persisted source, syntax and layout are rechecked afterward. These timings are excluded from latency acceptance; use the separate no-collection cohort for natural resident-memory peak.

peakMeasurementScope: Periodic collection study; uninterrupted natural peak comes from the separate normal cohort
